records.question: How did Paul become an apostle?
records.answer: Paul became an apostle through Jesus Christ and God the Father.

records.question: From what have believers in Jesus Christ been delivered?
records.answer: Believers in Jesus Christ have been delivered from this present evil age.

records.question: With what is Paul amazed with the church in Galatia?
records.answer: Paul is amazed that they are turning so quickly to a different gospel.

records.question: How many true gospels are there?
records.answer: There is only one true gospel, the gospel of Christ.

records.question: What does Paul say should happen to anyone proclaiming a different gospel than the gospel of Christ?
records.answer: Paul says anyone proclaiming a different gospel should be cursed.

records.question: Servants of Christ must seek the approval of whom first?
records.answer: Servants of Christ must seek the approval of God first.

records.question: How did Paul receive the knowledge of the gospel of Christ?
records.answer: Paul received the gospel of Christ by revelation from Jesus Christ directly to himself.

records.question: What was Paul doing in his life before he received the revelation of the gospel of Christ?
records.answer: Paul was following Judaism zealously, persecuting the church of God and destroying it.

records.question: When did God choose Paul to be his apostle?
records.answer: God was pleased to choose Paul from his mother’s womb to be his apostle.

records.question: For what purpose did God choose Paul as his apostle?
records.answer: God chose Paul as his apostle so that Paul would proclaim Christ among the Gentiles.

records.question: Where did Paul finally meet some of the other apostles?
records.answer: Finally, Paul went to Jerusalem and met the apostles Cephas and James.

records.question: What were the churches in Judea hearing about Paul?
records.answer: The churches in Judea were hearing that Paul, who once persecuted the church, was now proclaiming the faith.

records.question: What did Paul do when he went up to Jerusalem after 14 years?
records.answer: Paul spoke privately to the leaders of the church, explaining to them the gospel that he was proclaiming.

records.question: What was Titus, a Gentile, not required to do?
records.answer: Titus was not required to be circumcised.

records.question: What did the false brothers desire to do?
records.answer: The false brothers desired to make Paul and his companions slaves to the law.

records.question: Did the leaders of the church in Jerusalem change Paul’s message?
records.answer: No, they added nothing to Paul’s message.

records.question: To whom was Paul primarily sent to proclaim the gospel?
records.answer: Paul was primarily sent to the uncircumcised, the Gentiles, to proclaim the gospel.

records.question: To whom was Peter primarily sent to proclaim the gospel?
records.answer: Peter was primarily sent to the circumcised, the Jews, to proclaim the gospel.

records.question: How did the leaders in Jerusalem show their approval of Paul’s ministry?
records.answer: The leaders in Jerusalem gave Paul and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship to show their approval.

records.question: What error did Peter make when he came to Antioch?
records.answer: Peter stopped eating with the Gentiles, because he feared the men who had been circumcised.

records.question: What did Paul ask Cephas in front of everyone?
records.answer: Paul asked Cephas how he could force Gentiles to live like Jews when Cephas was living like a Gentile.

records.question: Paul said that no one is justified by what?
records.answer: Paul said that no one is justified by the works of the law.

records.question: How is a person justified before God?
records.answer: A person is justified before God by faith in Christ Jesus.

records.question: If someone returns to trying to follow the law after having faith in Christ, what does Paul say he has actually become?
records.answer: Paul says he shows himself actually to be a law breaker.

records.question: Who did Paul say now lived in him?
records.answer: Paul said that Christ now lived in him.

records.question: What does Paul say the Son of God did for him?
records.answer: Paul says the Son of God loved him and gave himself for Paul.

records.question: How was Abraham considered righteous before God?
records.answer: Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.

records.question: Who are the sons of Abraham?
records.answer: Those who believe God are the sons of Abraham.

records.question: The scripture foresaw that the Gentiles would be justified in what way?
records.answer: The scripture foresaw that the Gentiles would be justified by faith.

records.question: Those who rely on the works of the law to be justified are under what?
records.answer: Those who rely on the works of the law to be justified are under a curse.

records.question: How many people have been justified by God through the works of the law?
records.answer: No one has been justified through the works of the law.

records.question: Why did Christ redeem us by becoming a curse for us?
records.answer: Christ redeemed us by becoming a curse for us so that the blessing upon Abraham might come to the Gentiles.

records.question: Who was the “descendant” that was spoken of in the promise to Abraham?
records.answer: The “descendant” spoken of in the promise to Abraham was Christ.

records.question: Did the coming of the Jewish law 430 years after Abraham void the promise God made to Abraham?
records.answer: No, the law did not void the promise made to Abraham.

records.question: Why then was there the law?
records.answer: The law came because of transgressions until Abraham’s descendant came.

records.question: What did the law in scripture imprison everyone under?
records.answer: The law in scripture imprisoned everyone under sin.

records.question: How are we released from the imprisonment of the law?
records.answer: We are released from the imprisonment of the law by faith in Christ Jesus.

records.question: Who has been clothed in Christ?
records.answer: All who have been baptized into Christ have been clothed in Christ.

records.question: What different kinds of persons are made one in Christ Jesus?
records.answer: Jews, Greeks, slaves, free, male, and female are all made one in Christ Jesus.

records.question: How does the heir of an estate live while he is a child?
records.answer: The heir lives like a slave under guardians and trustees until the time set by his father.

records.question: What did God do at the right time in history?
records.answer: At the right time, God sent forth his Son to redeem those under the law.

records.question: How did God bring children who were under the law into his family?
records.answer: God adopted as sons the children who were under the law.

records.question: What does God send forth into the hearts of his children?
records.answer: God sends forth the Spirit of his Son into the hearts of his children.

records.question: Before we know God, to whom are we slaves?
records.answer: Before we know God, we are slaves to the spirits that rule the world, who are not gods at all.

records.question: As he sees the Galatians turning back, what does Paul fear for them?
records.answer: Paul fears that the Galatians will become slaves again, and that he has labored in vain over them.

records.question: Paul was perplexed that the Galatians were returning to what?
records.answer: Paul was perplexed that the Galatians were returning again to the ruling spirits of the world.

records.question: When Paul first came to the Galatians, what problem did he have?
records.answer: When Paul first came to the Galatians, he had a physical illness.

records.question: Despite Paul’s problem, how did the Galatians receive him?
records.answer: Despite Paul’s problem, the Galatians received Paul as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus.

records.question: Who are the false teachers in Galatia trying to separate?
records.answer: The false teachers are trying to separate the Galatians from Paul.

records.question: Under what are the false teachers trying to put the Galatians?
records.answer: The false teachers are trying to put the Galatians back under the law.

records.question: From which two kinds of women did Abraham have two sons?
records.answer: Abraham had two sons, one from a slave woman and one from a free woman.

records.question: Who is the symbolic mother of Paul and the believing Galatians?
records.answer: The Jerusalem above, the free woman, is the symbolic mother of Paul and the believing Galatians.

records.question: Are believers in Christ children of the flesh or children of the promise?
records.answer: Believers in Christ are children of the promise.

records.question: Who persecutes the children of the promise?
records.answer: The children of the flesh persecute the children of the promise.

records.question: With whom do the children of the slave woman not inherit?
records.answer: The children of the slave woman do not inherit along with the children of the free woman.

records.question: Are believers in Christ children of the slave woman or children of the free woman?
records.answer: Believers in Christ are children of the free woman.

records.question: For what purpose has Christ set us free?
records.answer: For freedom Christ has set us free.

records.question: What did Paul warn the Galatians would happen if they became circumcised?
records.answer: Paul said that if the Galatians became circumcised, Christ would not benefit them in any way.

records.question: What did Paul warn would happen to all the Galatians who would seek to be justified by following the law?
records.answer: Paul warned that all the Galatians who would seek to be justified by following the law would be alienated from Christ and would fall away from grace.

records.question: As opposed to circumcision and uncircumcised, what is the only thing that means anything in Christ Jesus?
records.answer: In Christ Jesus, only faith working through love means anything.

records.question: Of what is Paul confident regarding the one who has confused the Galatians about the gospel?
records.answer: Paul is confident that the one who has confused the Galatians about the gospel will bear God’s judgment.

records.question: Paul says that proclaiming circumcision does what?
records.answer: Paul says that in proclaiming circumcision, the stumbling block of the cross would be destroyed.

records.question: How are believers not to use their freedom in Christ?
records.answer: Believers are to not use their freedom in Christ as an opportunity for the flesh.

records.question: How are believers to use their freedom in Christ?
records.answer: Believers are to use their freedom in Christ to serve one another in love.

records.question: The whole law is fulfilled in what one commandment?
records.answer: The whole law is fulfilled in the commandment, “You must love your neighbor as yourself.”

records.question: How can believers not fulfill the lust of the flesh?
records.answer: Believers can live by the Spirit, and thus, not fulfill the lust of the flesh.

records.question: What two things are opposed to each other within the believer?
records.answer: The Spirit and the flesh are opposed to each other within the believer.

records.question: What are three examples of works of the flesh?
records.answer: Three examples of works of the flesh are any three of the following list: sexual immorality, impurity, lustfulness, idolatry, sorcery, hostility, strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, rivalry, dissension, sectarian division, envy, drunkenness, and drunken riots.

records.question: What will those who practice the works of the flesh not receive?
records.answer: Those who practice the works of the flesh will not inherit the kingdom of God.

records.question: What is the fruit of the Spirit?
records.answer: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control.

records.question: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have done what with the flesh and its passions?
records.answer: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh and its passions.

records.question: What should those who are spiritual do if a man is caught in some transgression?
records.answer: Those who are spiritual should restore that man in a spirit of gentleness.

records.question: For what danger must those who are spiritual watch out?
records.answer: Those who are spiritual must watch out that they are not also tempted.

records.question: How do believers fulfill the law of Christ?
records.answer: Believers fulfill the law of Christ by carrying one another’s burdens.

records.question: How can a person have something in himself to be proud of regarding his work?
records.answer: A person can have something in himself to be proud of by examining his own work, without comparing himself to anyone else.

records.question: What must one who is taught the word do with his teacher?
records.answer: One who is taught the word must share all good things with his teacher.

records.question: What happens to whatever a man spiritually plants?
records.answer: Whatever a man spiritually plants he will harvest.

records.question: What does a man harvest who plants to his own flesh?
records.answer: A man who plants to his own flesh harvests destruction out of his flesh.

records.question: What does a man harvest who plants to the Spirit?
records.answer: Out of the Spirit a man who plants to the Spirit harvests eternal life.

records.question: If a believer does not give up and continues doing good, what will he receive?
records.answer: A believer who continues doing good will reap a harvest.

records.question: To whom should believers especially do good?
records.answer: Believers should especially do good to those of the household of faith.

records.question: What is the motivation of those who want to compel the believers to be circumcised?
records.answer: Those who want to compel the believers to be circumcised do not want to be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

records.question: Of what did Paul say he was proud?
records.answer: Paul said that he was proud of the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ.

records.question: Instead of circumcision or uncircumcision, what is important?
records.answer: What is important is a new creation.

records.question: Upon whom does Paul wish peace and mercy?
records.answer: Paul wishes peace and mercy upon those who live by the rule of the new creation and upon the Israel of God.

records.question: What did Paul carry on his body?
records.answer: Paul carried the marks of Jesus on his body.
